audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. the pressure-gradient estimate has false regimes; wave-speed differentiation loses a source term; the hair-trigger proof uses an impossible static subsolution
limitations: Counterevidence: First example uses bounded noncompact class explicitly stated in Lemma; second is compact and even. Main asymptotics require p>=2; Theorem2.6 only needs unspecified bound at fixedtau,rho.
Counterevidence: p2 missingfactor is1; actual c' may remain strictly negative with profile-dependent bounds.
Counterevidence: Energy argument disproves this construction for all sufficiently regular beta,sigma, not hair-trigger conclusion itself.
Counterevidence: N>=2 excess logretreat diverges; parts i-ii unrefuted.
Counterevidence: Laterp32 usescorrectnormalization; positive exponent still exists.
Counterevidence: Explicit corrections restore chain rule and needed boundedness. Remaining barrier still depends on corrected parameter theory.
Limitations: Actual source publisher-typeset institutional online-first45p; current restricted EMS bytes not compared.
Limitations: Older differently titled arXiv candidate not used as equivalent.
Limitations: External regularity, eternal-solution and transferred convergence proofs not independently reproved in full.
Limitations: No author code executed; no exact-version author TeX/supplement/code verified.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Pressure-gradient estimate false in stated convection and p<2 regimes

Variation source |P|^(p-2) missing; universal c' in(-m,0) false

Static bump subsolution and ensuing temporal monotonicity proof invalid

Uniform convergence region includes front in N1

Tail and pressure normalization omit1/m

Missing logarithmic phase and associated local formula corrections
